goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann politische Maßnahmen als Antwort auf sozialen Wandel vergleichen.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: Qualification/training and financial support/advice are offered as two possible responses and explicitly described as complementary. The thoughtful comparison and conceptual time/skills balance avoid implying an automatic employment outcome, mutually exclusive policy choices or exact benefit entitlements.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px both measure headings, learning/advice scenes, money purse and comparison scale remain recognizable; secondary book labels are optional.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px the complementary sentence and the different response mechanisms are legible without legal detail.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The instructor and counselor face the participants; blank/generic documents do not carry actor-inverted required text. The training laptop is reasonably angled toward its learner.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people, without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: The scale illustrates comparing considerations, not physical equivalence of time and skills or a quantitative optimal policy.
goalTextStatus: Actual current canonical German title/description inspected and matched to bilingual E1 author candidate; no D/P gate attested by this image review.
